issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (subtle grain) / §4.1 one soft texture = minor
issues.fix: Add a 2-3% value-noise grain or a vertex-colour gradient to the sand planes at low frequency (about 64 px scale)

issues.region: grass blades and agave edges against the sand, centre-left
issues.problem: Thin grass blades show slight stair-step aliasing on their edges at 1280x720.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no aliasing) / §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Turn on MSAA 4x or TAA for the vegetation pass, or use alpha-to-coverage on the grass cards

issues.problem: There's no game state to read. The subject reads instantly, but the small right-hand island's windows and railings shrink into mush at 720p JPEG, so the secondary subject is soft on stream.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 / §4.1: with no game state, judge how instantly the subject reads at 720p
issues.fix: Scale the secondary island up about 15% or bring it closer to the camera so its window grid stays at 4 px or more at 720p

issues.problem: The central tower's wall tiles push towards near-white. They're a touch hotter than the rest of the muted pastel set and pull a little attention.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3: no pure white; controlled saturation and value
issues.fix: Tint the tower's whites to a warm cream (about #EDE4D6) and lower their value about 5%

issues.problem: The overcast ambient light is deliberate, but the key direction is weak: the faces facing left and right differ only slightly in value, so the masses flatten a little on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4: clear key light; pieces lift off through shading
issues.fix: Raise the directional key's intensity about 15% from the upper left so the lit and shaded faces separate more clearly

issues.region: roof ridges and wall corners, centre cluster
issues.problem: The wall corners and roof eaves are crisp, unbevelled edges. The chunky toy silhouettes carry the form, but the edge softness is weaker than on the board's soft-form frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5: every edge beveled or rounded
issues.fix: Add a 1–2 px bevel or an edge-highlight shader on the wall corners and roof ridges

issues.problem: The dark arch opening and the dark iron gantry near x≈625 are the frame's highest-contrast darks. On a second look they compete with the tower as the focal point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Lift the arch interior and gantry darks by about 10% value with fog tint so the tower top stays the peak of contrast

issues.problem: The main island's base and reflections sit very close to the bottom edge while the top-right fog holds a lot of empty space, so the framing weights slightly low.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents
issues.fix: Tilt or pan the camera down about 30 px so the island bases clear the bottom edge by at least 6% of frame height

issues.problem: The wall tile grid repeats uniformly across several buildings, so the repeating pattern is visible on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10: no visible tiling; subtle grain
issues.fix: Add per-building UV offset and about 5% per-tile value jitter to break up the repeat

issues.region: railings and stairs, lower-left and right island
issues.problem: The thin railings and stair rails show slight stair-step aliasing along their diagonals.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18: no aliasing shimmer
issues.fix: Enable TAA or 4x MSAA, or thicken the railing geometry to at least 1.5 px at 720p

issues.region: centre, tall white tower and white wings
issues.problem: The white-tiled buildings read flatter and more procedural than the hand-painted coloured houses around them, so the plaster material style is slightly uneven across the town.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted world); §4.1 reference band, minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Give the white facades the same per-tile hue jitter and grime/AO pass as the coloured facades (±3% value, warm tint).

issues.problem: The secondary island and the gull silhouettes are low-contrast against the teal fog. At 720p JPEG they fall into the haze and read later than 1 s.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (subject reads instantly at 720p); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Lift fog density near the right island by about 15%, or add a 1-2 px warm rim on its roof edges to separate it from the sky.

issues.problem: The lit faces of the white tower approach pure white, which is the palette's one hot value against an otherwise muted, tinted scheme.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (no pure white; tinted values); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Clamp the brightest facade values to a warm off-white, around #F2EBDF, instead of near #FFFFFF.

issues.problem: The overcast ambient light is deliberate and polished, but the key direction is weak. Building masses separate mainly through local colour rather than light and shadow, so the form modelling is a little soft on second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (clear key light, pieces lift off); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Raise the directional key-to-fill ratio from about 1.3:1 to 1.8:1, with the key from upper left, and add contact AO where houses meet the quay.

issues.region: left-centre, railings, stair rails and black iron bridge
issues.problem: The railings and the dark iron bridge are spindly, single-pixel-thin lines that break the chunky toy silhouette language set by the roofs and towers.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (chunky toy silhouettes, no spindly shapes); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Thicken railing posts and rails to at least 2-3 px at 720p, with rounded caps, and lighten the bridge from near-black to the slate tone of the quay.

issues.problem: The right island is a detailed second focal cluster that pulls the eye from the main town a little, so the focal hierarchy is not quite singular.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Push the right island about 20% deeper into the fog (lower contrast and saturation) so it reads as context, not a second subject.

issues.problem: The main island's base and reflection sit very close to the bottom and left edges. This near-tangent crowds the mass, while the upper right keeps a large empty sky.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (breathing room, no awkward tangents); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Pull the camera back about 5% and tilt it down slightly, leaving at least 40 px of water below and to the left of the quay.

issues.problem: The right island's left quay edge nearly lines up with the main island's rightmost spire column, which creates a mild visual tangent across the water gap.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (no awkward tangents); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Shift the secondary island about 30 px right, or lower it about 20 px, to open the negative space between the two masses.

issues.problem: The facade tile pattern repeats as a regular grid with little variation, so the tiling is noticeable on the large white and green walls on second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (no visible tiling, subtle grain); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Add a low-frequency variation mask (2-4 m scale) and per-tile value noise of ±4% to break the grid repetition.

issues.problem: The water is a flat teal plane with soft reflections but almost no surface grain, so it reads less like a material than the stone and plaster do.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (surfaces read as materials); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Add a subtle low-amplitude normal ripple (0.02 strength) and a faint Fresnel brightening toward the horizon.

issues.problem: The frame reads as premium indie, but the thin dark railings and the flat white facades are the small points a stranger could pick at next to the board.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15 (a stranger believes it's premium indie); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Apply the item 1 and item 5 fixes: vary the white facade texture and use chunkier, tinted railings.

issues.problem: The thin railing and truss lines show stair-step aliasing and would shimmer in motion.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no aliasing shimmer); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Enable TAA or 4x MSAA with alpha-to-coverage on the railing geometry, or thicken the lines past 2 px.

issues.problem: The near-black wardrobe body is a large flat slab with less hand-placed pixel detail than the boxes, bed and shelves, so it reads slightly heavier and plainer than the rest of the room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted direction); §4.1 reference band minor flaw
issues.fix: Lift the wardrobe base to a warm charcoal (~#3a3440) and add a 1-px lighter edge highlight and subtle panel grain to match the bed frame's detail level

issues.problem: The small props (pencil cup, mouse, blue cable box on the bed) crowd together at 720p, so which item is the one to interact with takes a beat to find.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 (subject reads within 1 s at 720p); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Give the active or focus prop a 1-px warm outline or a gentle 10% brightness lift so it stands out from the neighbouring clutter

issues.problem: The wardrobe and desk surface go close to pure black, which the rubric's palette discipline avoids.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (no pure black; tinted shadows)
issues.fix: Shift the darkest values to a tinted navy-violet (~#2e2a3c) to match the purple backdrop

issues.problem: The saturated royal-blue chair is the one hot accent that jumps out of the otherwise muted warm palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (controlled saturation); §4.1 'one hot accent'
issues.fix: Lower the chair's saturation by ~15% and warm its hue slightly toward the backdrop's periwinkle

issues.problem: Shading is mostly soft ambient, and objects cast only faint contact shadows, so the window's light direction barely reads on the floor and boxes.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4 (clear key light; pieces lift off the surface); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a soft warm window-light patch on the floor and bed, plus 10–15% darker contact shadows under the boxes and chair on the side away from the window

issues.problem: The thin black shelf brackets and chair base are spindly next to the chunky boxes and bed.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5 (chunky silhouettes, no spindly shapes)
issues.fix: Thicken the brackets and chair legs by 1 px and round their end caps

issues.problem: The three large boxes, the pig plush and the red bed all compete for the eye, and no single object is clearly the focal point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (one obvious focal point); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Mute the bed's red by ~15% so the boxes and plush become the clear focus

issues.problem: The high-contrast red plaid shirt pulls attention away from the centre on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (action → state → context flow)
issues.fix: Lower the shirt's contrast and saturation by ~10%

issues.region: right edge and top-left, room walls
issues.problem: The room's right wall edge sits close to the frame edge, and the top-left wall corner is cropped, which leaves the room slightly off-balance.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room, no tangents)
issues.fix: Pull the camera out ~5% and shift it about 20 px left so both wall edges have an even margin

issues.problem: The wood-grain dither on the dark wardrobe side panel reads as faint noise instead of a material.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (subtle grain that reads as material)
issues.fix: Replace the dither with 2–3 directional grain strokes per panel at ≤8% value contrast

issues.problem: The flat purple checker backdrop is a little plain next to the lavish detail inside the room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 (premium gut check); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a soft radial vignette (~10%) and a faint drop shadow under the room cutaway

issues.problem: The diagonal glare lines on the window are rendered at a sub-pixel angle, so their edges look soft next to the crisp pixel grid.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18 (no aliasing)
issues.fix: Snap the glare to 2:1 isometric pixel steps with hard edges

issues.problem: The saturated royal-blue office chair is noticeably hotter than the rest of the muted, warm props, so it reads slightly apart from the cohesive art direction on a second look.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one cohesive world); §4.1 reference-band minor flaw (one hot accent) -0.2
issues.fix: Lower the chair's saturation about 15% and shift the hue toward the room's dusty indigo (around #3F4FA8 instead of #1F3FD8).

issues.problem: Small props (the cable bundle on the bed, the pen pot, the ruler) turn into mush at 720p, so any interactable detail on them would take more than 1 s to read.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (clear within 1 s at 720p); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Add a 1 px lighter outline or a highlight pixel row to props smaller than 24 px so they separate from the bedspread and desk top.

issues.problem: The walls are close to pure cool white (about #E8EAF0) and pull toward sterile, against a warm cozy palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (no pure black or white); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Tint the wall base warmer and darker, e.g. #DCD6CC, and keep the cool shade only in the corner shadow.

issues.problem: The wardrobe and desk top sit close to near-black charcoal with little hue, so the darkest values look untinted.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (tinted shadows, no pure black); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Shift the darkest charcoal to a tinted navy-brown such as #2A2838, and raise its value by 4–6%.

issues.problem: The daylit window casts no light pool on the floor or bed, so the lighting reads mostly flat and ambient, and objects lift through outlines rather than light.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (clear key light, pieces lift off); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Add a soft, warm, low-opacity parallelogram of window light (about 12% #FFE9C2) across the bed and floor, and put a darker contact shadow under the chair and the boxes.

issues.region: left, clothes hangers and chair base
issues.problem: The wire hangers and the chair's star base are 1 px spindly lines that break the chunky prop silhouettes elsewhere.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (chunky silhouettes, no spindly shapes); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Thicken the hanger and chair-leg strokes to 2 px and round their ends.

issues.region: right 40%, stacked boxes vs left wardrobe
issues.problem: The large box stack on the right and the dark wardrobe on the left have similar visual weight, so the eye has no single obvious starting point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Drop the wardrobe interior value 10% or lift the box stack's highlight, so that the box being unpacked becomes the single focal point.

issues.problem: The top of the wardrobe and the room cutaway's front edge run into the frame edges, which makes tangents at the top-left and bottom-right.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (breathing room, no awkward tangents); §4.1 minor flaw -0.2
issues.fix: Zoom out about 6% and pan the camera 20 px down-left so that the room block has at least 24 px margin on all sides.

issues.problem: A thin sliver of the blue checker background shows at the right edge next to the shelves, which reads as slightly unbalanced dead space against the tight left edge.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (no dead space); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Centre the room horizontally by panning 30 px right, so that the margins match on the left and right.

issues.problem: The wood floor and the cardboard read as materials, but the walls are a flat fill with only a few specks and no plaster grain.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (subtle grain, materials read); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Add a sparse 2-tone dither of plaster grain to the walls at about 4% value variation.

issues.problem: The frame is premium overall, but the flat wall lighting and the hot chair accent keep it a notch under the board's most finished frames.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15; §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Apply the fixes in CAL-R1-01 and CAL-R1-05 (warm window light and a desaturated chair).

issues.problem: The pixel edges look slightly soft, as if scaled with filtering rather than by a clean integer nearest-neighbour step.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no aliasing or scaling artefacts); §4.1 minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Render at an integer scale with nearest-neighbour sampling (image-rendering: pixelated) and letterbox any leftover space.

issues.problem: The background man-made props (grey tower, chain-link fence, parked cars) are more literal and less stylised than the chunky faceted trees and soft ground, which slightly dilutes the handcrafted world.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one cohesive world), §4.1 reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Give the fence and cars the same faceted, warm-tinted treatment as the foliage, or add 15–20% more atmospheric fog to push them back

issues.problem: The subject is only about 60 px tall at 720p. At stream JPEG quality it gets smaller relative to the busy foliage around it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (subject reads within 1 s at 720p), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Pull the camera about 15% closer, or lower the FOV so the character fills about 12% of the frame height

issues.problem: The small squirrel, a secondary story beat, is under 30 px and blends into the log's warm tones, so it is easy to miss at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2, §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a subtle 1–2 px darker rim or a stronger value contrast (+15% lightness gap) between the squirrel and the log

issues.problem: The shaded trunks lean toward a neutral cool grey rather than a warm-tinted shadow, which is slightly off the otherwise sunny ochre palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (tinted shadows), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Shift the shadow tint of the trunk shading about 8° toward violet-brown and add +5% saturation

issues.problem: The foreground shadow region is large and slightly flat, with little bounce light, so the lower-left corner reads a touch murky.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (clear key, pieces lift), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Raise the ambient/bounce fill in the shadowed foreground by about 10% with a warm ground-bounce tint

issues.problem: The canopy facets meet at hard angular edges that feel a bit sharper than the soft, rounded character and log.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (rounded forms, chunky silhouettes), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a small bevel or normal smoothing (about 15°) on the canopy clusters to soften the silhouette edges

issues.problem: The bright green palm bush directly behind the character competes with the character's red cap for attention.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Desaturate the bush by about 15% or darken it by 10% so the red cap is the dominant accent

issues.problem: The dense high-frequency grass and trunks across the frame give the eye many stops before it lands on the character.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6, §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a subtle depth-of-field or 10% vignette to calm the frame edges

issues.problem: The log runs straight into the bottom edge and the second log stub makes a tangent against it, so the frame's lead-in reads cramped.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (awkward tangents), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Raise the camera about 5° or shift it right so the second log stub separates from the main log at the bottom edge

issues.problem: The foreground palm fronds are cut off at the left edge and read as an accidental crop.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7, §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Either commit to a deliberate framing element that fills more of the edge, or pan the camera about 40 px to exclude it

issues.problem: The log's stone-like mottled pattern reads more like pebbles than wood grain, so it is ambiguous as a material.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (materials read), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Replace the blotch pattern with elongated grain strokes that run along the log axis, at about 8% value variation

issues.problem: The literal fence, cars and tower in the background slightly undercut the premium storybook feel.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15, §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Stylise the background props to match the foliage, or fog them 20% further

issues.region: mid-left thin branches and chain-link fence
issues.problem: The thin twigs and the fence mesh show slight stair-step aliasing that would shimmer in motion.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no aliasing shimmer), §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Enable TAA or MSAA 4x, or thicken the thin branch geometry to at least 2 px on screen

issues.problem: The background man-made props (fine mesh fence, tall pale tower, car) read a little more literal and less handcrafted than the chunky faceted trees and log, which dilutes the one-world cohesion slightly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one cohesive art direction); §4.1 reference band minor flaw -0.1
issues.fix: Swap the fence mesh for 3-4 chunky posts with a thick 2-strand wire, and push the tower 15% further into the warm atmospheric haze so it matches the faceted foliage language.

issues.problem: The player character takes up only about 8% of frame height, and the dark backpack and shorts sit against a shadowed log. At 720p JPEG it reads mostly as the red cap.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (subject reads instantly at 720p); §4.1 minor -0.2
issues.fix: Pull the camera about 20% closer, or add a 1-2 px warm rim light on the character's silhouette to separate it from the log shadow.

issues.problem: The foreground haze lowers contrast in the lower-left grass and log, so that part of the frame goes muddy under stream compression.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2; §4.1 minor -0.1
issues.fix: Cut the near-camera fog density by about 30% below the 60% screen-height line so the foreground keeps its value contrast.

issues.problem: Sky gaps between the canopy clusters get close to pure white and clip, a cold spot in an otherwise warm, disciplined palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (no pure white); §4.1 minor -0.1
issues.fix: Cap sky luminance around #EDE6D8 with a warm tint so the gaps stay inside the ochre/teal palette.

issues.problem: The foreground depth fog flattens the lighting where it is closest to the camera. The log and grass in the near plane lose their key-light modelling and go milky.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (clear key light, forms lift); §4.1 minor -0.2
issues.fix: Start the fog at about 8 m from the camera instead of 0, and keep the near-plane shadows at their full tinted value.

issues.problem: The dry grass tufts are thin, spiky blades. They are the one spindly shape in a set that is otherwise chunky and rounded.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (chunky toy silhouettes); §4.1 minor -0.1
issues.fix: Widen the grass blade cards by about 1.5x and round the tips so the tufts read as clumped shapes.

issues.problem: The bright green palm bush sits right behind the character's head and competes with it as the focal point. The squirrel also pulls the eye a little.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point); §4.1 minor -0.2
issues.fix: Move the palm bush about 120 px to the left or darken it about 15%, so the red cap is the only high-contrast shape in the centre third.

issues.region: bottom-left corner (log end) and top edge (trunks)
issues.problem: The near end of the log exits at the bottom-left corner and makes a tangent with the frame edge. Two trunks also touch the top edge in a way that crowds the canopy.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (awkward tangents); §4.1 minor -0.2
issues.fix: Rotate the camera yaw about 5° to the right so the log enters from the bottom edge rather than the corner, and lift the horizon about 20 px.

issues.problem: The dark, out-of-focus foreground foliage on the far left is a heavy, fairly dead block that pushes the composition to the right.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (dead space); §4.1 minor -0.1
issues.fix: Trim the left foreground foliage to about 8% of frame width, or brighten it about 10% so it frames the shot instead of blocking it.

issues.problem: The circular stone-like blotches on the log top repeat at a regular rhythm and look soft, so the surface reads less like wood than the rest of the materials read as what they are.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (no visible tiling, reads as material); §4.1 minor -0.2
issues.fix: Break the log-top pattern with a 2x scale variation and a directional bark-grain stroke so it reads as wood.

issues.problem: The milky foreground haze makes the lower half look slightly washed out next to the crisper board frames. This is the only thing that makes the frame feel less than fully finished.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15; §4.1 minor -0.1
issues.fix: Reduce the near fog and add +5% contrast to the bottom 40% of the frame in grading.

issues.region: top 30% canopy edges and bottom-right grass cards
issues.problem: Faint stair-step aliasing shows on the faceted canopy silhouettes against the bright sky, and the alpha-cut grass cards have slightly hard edges.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no aliasing); §4.1 minor -0.2
issues.fix: Turn on MSAA 4x or TAA, and use alpha-to-coverage on the grass cards.

issues.region: top-center rotate arrows and top-right gear
issues.problem: The flat white rotate arrows and gear glyph don't match the framed, painted tiles in the bottom toolbar, so they read as a second, more generic UI style.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1 (UI reads as one world); §4.1 reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Put both glyphs in the toolbar's 8 px rounded tile with a paper fill and a warm 2 px outline, and tint the glyph a warm off-white such as #F4EBDD

issues.problem: The toolbar glyphs are about 20 px inside 40 px tiles. After 720p JPEG compression, the pale-tile icons (flower, water drop, sun) blur together.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2 (state clear within 1 s at 720p)
issues.fix: Make tiles 48 px with 28 px glyphs, and add a 1.5 px darker glyph outline to the pale tiles

issues.region: top-right gear, top-center arrows; foreground lupins
issues.problem: The UI glyphs use near-pure white, and several foreground lupins are close to saturated violet, which is hotter than the rest of the muted palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3 (no pure white; controlled saturation)
issues.fix: Change the UI white to a warm off-white such as #F4EBDD, and lower lupin saturation about 10% in the foreground band

issues.problem: The central rock mass has hard, faceted low-poly planes with sharp creases. That clashes with the soft, rounded ruins and foliage.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5 (every edge beveled or rounded)
issues.fix: Add a bevel or smoothing pass so rock creases get a 2–4 cm rounded edge, or soften them with smoothed normals

issues.region: centre ruin (heart and hand cursor) vs flower beds at the edges
issues.problem: The interaction focus (heart plus hand cursor) is small. Bright lupins and white blossoms across the frame compete with it for attention.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6 (one obvious focal point)
issues.fix: Add a soft 15% radial light falloff toward the frame edges, and scale the heart indicator from about 24 px to 32 px

issues.region: bottom 12%, toolbar over the foreground flower bed
issues.problem: The toolbar sits directly on busy foreground flowers, which crowds the bottom-left corner and leaves the toolbar no breathing room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7 (breathing room, no awkward crowding)
issues.fix: Add a soft 10% dark vignette or blurred backing strip about 64 px tall behind the toolbar, or tilt the camera up 3° to clear the foreground

issues.problem: Icon treatment is inconsistent: the toolbar tiles are outlined and filled, while the rotate control is a bare glyph with no container or state.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 9 (one icon stroke weight, consistent components)
issues.fix: Give the rotate control the same tile container, radius and 2 px stroke as the toolbar icons

issues.problem: The rock surface is flat-shaded, with no grain or lichen detail, so it reads as a less finished material than the stone bricks and grass.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10 (materials read, subtle grain)
issues.fix: Add a subtle painted stone grain and moss tint to the rock shader at about 8% strength

issues.problem: Several tool tiles are told apart mainly by background hue (orange, green, teal). Under deuteranopia, the orange and green tiles become similar and only the small glyphs separate them.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 11 (colour plus glyph identity; colour-vision simulation)
issues.fix: Enlarge the glyphs to 28 px and vary tile luminance by at least 20% between neighbouring tools

issues.problem: The white gear sits on sunlit pale foliage, so its contrast is well under 4.5:1.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 11 (contrast ≥ 4.5:1)
issues.fix: Put the gear on a 40 px rounded dark translucent tile at rgba(40,30,20,0.45)

issues.problem: The scene is fully premium, but the thin, generic top controls are the one element that feels like placeholder UI next to the art.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15 (believed premium throughout)
issues.fix: Restyle the top controls to match the toolbar, as in CAL-R1-01 and CAL-R1-07

issues.region: top-center canopy and left grass blades
issues.problem: Canopy highlights clip toward flat white near the top edge, and thin grass blades on the left show slight stair-stepping aliasing.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 18 (no aliasing, no blown highlights/banding)
issues.fix: Lower bloom and exposure on the canopy highlights by about 0.3 EV, and turn on TAA or alpha-to-coverage for the grass cards

issues.problem: The settings gear is a flat pure-white glyph with no tile. It doesn't match the painted, framed tiles in the bottom toolbar, so it reads as a stock icon.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1: UI reads as one handcrafted world, with no stock widgets
issues.fix: Put the gear on the same 40 px rounded tile as the toolbar, with the same cream fill, border and warm-dark glyph stroke

issues.problem: The toolbar glyphs are about 24 px and low-contrast on their tiles (sculpt and water especially). They would soften at 720p JPEG q60.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: the current state is clear within 1 s at stream quality
issues.fix: Make the glyphs 28 px or larger with a darker 2 px outline, and give the selected tool a stronger lift (a 4 px raise and a warm outline)

issues.region: top-right gear and top-centre rotate arrows
issues.problem: The gear and rotate-arrow icons are near-pure white, which runs hot against the warm, tinted palette of the scene.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: no pure black or white
issues.fix: Tint the icons to a warm cream such as #F4EBDD and add a soft warm-brown drop shadow

issues.problem: The shadow pool behind the right-hand ruin crushes towards a near-black green, and detail is lost there.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: clear key light, tinted soft shadows
issues.fix: Lift the ambient fill by about 10% and tint the shadows toward a blue-green (#2E3F3A) instead of letting them crush

issues.problem: The central boulder has hard, sharp facets that feel harsher than the softened brick and foliage around it.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: every edge beveled or rounded
issues.fix: Add a small bevel or smooth-normal pass to the boulder facets, or soften them with a normal blend of about 0.3

issues.problem: The stone bricks are fairly crisp cubes. They read slightly blocky at the silhouette edges on the wall tops.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5: chunky toy silhouettes, rounded
issues.fix: Give the brick corners a 1–2 px bevel radius

issues.problem: The saturated lupins and petal scatter around the edges compete with the heart and sheep interaction at the centre, which dilutes the focal point.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Add a 10–15% vignette and slightly desaturate the flora at the edges, so the eye rests on the central ruin

issues.region: centre, the heart and hand cursor
issues.problem: The heart and hand cursor are small against the busy clutter of the ruin, so the call to action takes a second look to find.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: clear call to action
issues.fix: Scale the heart about 20% larger and give it a soft 6 px cream halo

issues.problem: The toolbar sits flush against the bottom edge (about 4 px margin) and covers foreground flowers, which leaves no breathing room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: framing with breathing room
issues.fix: Raise the toolbar to a 16 px bottom margin

issues.problem: The toolbar is nearly clipped by the frame edge, and it has no visible selected state beyond the orange tile.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9: visible states, no clipping, 4-pt spacing
issues.fix: Keep a 16 px margin from the frame edge; show the selected tile with a 4 px lift and a 2 px warm outline

issues.region: top-right gear and top-centre rotate arrows
issues.problem: The floating top icons use a different, tileless style from the toolbar, so the icon system is inconsistent.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9: one icon stroke weight and consistent treatment
issues.fix: Unify on the toolbar tile style, with the same stroke weight (2 px) and radius

issues.problem: The leaf-card texture on the lit canopies repeats slightly in the highlights.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: no visible tiling
issues.fix: Randomise the leaf-card rotation and scale by ±15% per cluster

issues.region: bottom toolbar, the green and teal tiles
issues.problem: The light green and teal tiles have low glyph-to-tile contrast, and their hues are close under deuteranopia.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11: colour plus glyph identity; contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in principle
issues.fix: Darken the glyph strokes to reach 4.5:1 on each tile, and separate the green and teal tiles by value

issues.problem: The toolbar is the one element that feels slightly utilitarian next to the painterly scene.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15: premium indie gut check
issues.fix: Add a soft paper backing strip behind the toolbar, with 12 px radius and a warm shadow

issues.problem: The bright foliage edges show fine alpha-card shimmer and aliasing speckle.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18: no aliasing shimmer
issues.fix: Enable alpha-to-coverage on the foliage cards, or apply TAA with a sharpening of about 0.2

issues.problem: The castle's fine half-timber lines, window grids and brick detail are rendered more densely and realistically than the soft, blobby foliage and clouds, so the two read as slightly different levels of stylisation.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one cohesive handcrafted world); §4.1 reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Simplify the castle detail: halve the timber-beam count, widen the window mullions to at least 2 px at 720p and smooth the brick normal map so it matches the foliage's chunkier shapes.

issues.problem: The castle's lower half and its rock plinth sink into dark purple-brown midtones that nearly match the moat, so the subject's silhouette goes muddy at stream compression.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (subject reads instantly at 720p JPEG q60)
issues.fix: Lift the plinth and water shadows by about 10% luminance, or add a cool bounce light from the water so the base separates from the moat.

issues.problem: The brightest, highest-contrast area of the frame is the cloud bank, not the castle, so it competes with the castle for the first glance.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 / §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Take about 0.3 EV off the cloud highlights, or shift them toward a deeper lilac so the castle's lit roofs hold peak brightness.

issues.problem: A heavy magenta grade drains most hue variety: the foliage greens become grey-lilac and the roofs and stone merge into one warm-brown family.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (palette discipline, tinted but distinct hues)
issues.fix: Cut the global magenta LUT strength by about 25% and keep a desaturated sage (around #9DAE8A) in the foliage midtones.

issues.region: shadowed castle walls and moat, lower-left
issues.problem: The deepest shadows turn into a near-neutral murky brown instead of the frame's tinted violet, which slightly breaks the tinted-shadow discipline.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (tinted shadows, no near-black)
issues.fix: Clamp the shadow floor to about #3A2A4A and push the shadow hue toward violet.

issues.problem: The warm sunset key reaches only the roofs; the keep walls fall off into flat, unlit murk with no rim light separating them from the background trees.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (forms lift through key and rim light)
issues.fix: Add a low-intensity warm rim light (about 0.3x the key) from camera-right on the keep walls and the tower's edge.

issues.region: flagpoles and smoke wisps above the spires
issues.problem: The thin flagpoles and hair-thin smoke curls read as spindly next to the chunky, rounded trees.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (chunky toy silhouettes, nothing spindly)
issues.fix: Make the flagpoles at least 3 px thick at 720p and replace the smoke lines with soft, puffy billboards.

issues.region: foreground rock shards, bottom-left and bottom-centre
issues.problem: The rock plinth is made of sharp, faceted shards with hard points, which clash with the soft cloud and tree forms.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (every edge beveled or rounded)
issues.fix: Bevel the rock tips with a radius of about 8% of the shard width and soften their normals.

issues.problem: The glowing cloud bank pulls the eye up and right, away from the castle focal point, before it settles.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point)
issues.fix: Darken the clouds at the right edge with a 15% vignette so the brightest value stays on the castle roofs.

issues.problem: The secondary gatehouse sits in a lit patch and forms a second point of interest that competes with the main keep.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 / §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Lower the gatehouse exposure by about 0.3 EV or partly occlude it with foreground trees.

issues.region: bottom edge, rock shards and bottom-right trees
issues.problem: The foreground rock tips and bushes are cut off by the bottom frame edge, creating tangents.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (no awkward tangents)
issues.fix: Tilt the camera up about 3° or push the foreground rocks down so their tips clear the frame edge by at least 40 px.

issues.problem: The left-edge tree is sliced by the frame, while the tall tower sits close to the upper-left, which crowds that corner.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (breathing room)
issues.fix: Pan the camera about 4% to the right so the tower spire has more headroom and the cut tree drops out of frame.

issues.problem: The water surface is murky and reads as flat dark paint with little reflection definition, much weaker as a material than the stone and roof tiles.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (surfaces read as materials)
issues.fix: Raise the water's specular and reflection strength by about 20% and add a subtle normal-map ripple.

issues.problem: The underexposed lower half lets the frame's premium feel drop off from top to bottom; the rich sky is carrying the image.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15 (premium indie gut check)
issues.fix: Balance the exposure with a graduated lift of about 0.2 EV on the bottom 40%.

issues.region: flagpoles, smoke wisps and battlement crenellations, top-centre
issues.problem: The hair-thin smoke lines and pole edges show slight aliasing and stair-stepping that would shimmer in motion.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no aliasing shimmer)
issues.fix: Enable TAA or 2x MSAA for the thin geometry, or thicken the lines to at least 2 px at 720p.

issues.problem: The castle's fine half-timber and brick detail is more realistic than the soft, chunky stylised tree canopies, so there's a slight gap in how detailed the two are.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one world, one style); §4.1 reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Simplify the castle's brick and timber normal detail by about 30% and widen the bevels so the castle matches the soft canopy language.

issues.problem: At 720p JPEG quality, the lower half of the castle and the rock plinth sink into the dark shadowed water, so the silhouette softens at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (reads within 1 s at stream quality); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Raise the plinth's shadow value by about 10% L and add a faint rim of warm sky bounce on the rock edges.

issues.problem: The heavy violet haze drains the foreground towards a near-monochrome murky purple-brown, which dulls how cleanly the palette separates.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (tinted shadows, controlled palette); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Shift the foreground shadow tint slightly toward blue-teal (hue about 250°) and lift saturation by 5% so it separates from the pink sky.

issues.problem: The foreground rock spires are crushed to near-silhouette and have no fill light, so the lighting feels a little uneven.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (clear key, forms lift); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add a low-intensity cool fill at about 15% of the key so the rock faces keep mid-tone detail.

issues.problem: The pointed, sharp-edged rock spires break the otherwise soft, rounded forms.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (every edge beveled or rounded); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Round the tips of the spires with a 0.1-unit bevel and blunt their silhouettes.

issues.problem: The thin pennant flags and the wispy smoke threads read as spindly.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (chunky toy silhouettes); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Make the pennants about 1.5x thicker and the smoke plumes wider and puffier.

issues.problem: The brightly lit canopy at the bottom right is almost as bright as the castle's lit roofs, so it pulls attention off the focal point a little.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (one obvious focal point); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Darken the lower-right canopy by about 8% exposure with a vignette so the castle roofs stay the brightest mid-frame element.

issues.problem: The foreground rocks are cut off by the bottom frame edge, which makes a slightly awkward crop.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (no awkward tangents/crops); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Tilt the camera up about 3° or pull it back so the rock tips sit clear of the frame edge.

issues.problem: The bridge's far end is swallowed by the tree mass at the gatehouse, so its end forms a tangent with no clear endpoint.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (awkward tangents); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Clear a small gap in the trees behind the gatehouse so the bridge end reads against the sky.

issues.problem: The water reflections are soft and smeary compared with the crisp castle materials.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (materials read, no blurry art); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Increase the reflection resolution and add subtle ripple normals at low amplitude.

issues.problem: The murky dark bottom third is the one spot that keeps the frame just short of flawless premium polish.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15; §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Lift the lower-third exposure by 0.2 EV with a graduated grade.

issues.problem: There's faint noise and slight banding in the dark gradient of the water.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no banding); §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Add 1-bit blue-noise dither to the tonemap output.

issues.problem: The interactive item (boombox under the cursor) is small against the dense prop field, so at 720p JPEG the selection takes a second look to find.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2: current state clear within 1 s
issues.fix: Add a 2 px warm outline or soft glow to the hovered or held item and scale it up about 4% on hover

issues.problem: The soccer ball uses near pure black and white, the only neutral extremes in an otherwise lavender-tinted palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3: no pure black or white; tinted shadows
issues.fix: Tint the black panels to deep indigo (~#2a2440) and the white to a warm off-white (~#eef0f8)

issues.region: floor under boxes, cabinet and ladder
issues.problem: Contact shadows are faint or missing under several floor props (the cabinet and boxes), so they sit slightly flat on the carpet.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4: pieces lift off the board with blob shadow
issues.fix: Add a 1-tile, 25%-opacity indigo blob shadow offset down-right under each floor prop

issues.region: centre, boxes vs. bed and shelf
issues.problem: The saturated purple bed and pink plush compete with the open boxes (the action) for first read, so the focal hierarchy is slightly split.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Lower the bed-sheet saturation about 10% or add a gentle vignette around the box stack

issues.problem: The room's front floor corner and baseboard are cropped by the bottom frame edge, a tangent that clips the diorama.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents
issues.fix: Pull the camera back or shift the room up about 30 px so the front corner clears the bottom edge by ≥ 24 px

issues.problem: The carpet is a large, nearly uniform flat fill with little texture compared with the detailed wall planks and cardboard.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10: materials read, subtle grain
issues.fix: Add a sparse 2-tone pixel dither pattern at low contrast (±4% value) to the carpet

issues.region: left window sill, ~x320-400 y260-310, and Rubik's cube bottom-centre
issues.problem: The action figures on the sill and the Rubik's cube are only about 20-30 px, so at 720p JPEG they turn into colour smudges and their identity is lost at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2: the subject reads within 1 s at 720p q60
issues.fix: Scale the small props up about 1.25x, or give them a 1 px darker outline so they keep their silhouette after compression.

issues.region: soccer ball bottom-left, trophy base, boombox speakers
issues.problem: The soccer ball, trophy plinth and boombox grilles use near-pure black, and the curtains and ball use near-pure white. These values sit outside the tinted purple/blue palette the rest of the room uses.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3: no pure black or white; tinted shadows
issues.fix: Tint the darkest values toward the room's indigo (about #2a2440) and the whites toward a warm off-white (about #f4f0ea).

issues.region: window, left wall and floor below it
issues.problem: The window shows daylight, but no light from it falls on the floor or the dresser, so the room lighting is uniformly flat.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4: a clear key light gives the scene direction
issues.fix: Add a soft, low-opacity (about 15%) light parallelogram from the window onto the floor and the dresser top.

issues.region: floor under boxes, frog and soccer ball
issues.problem: Contact shadows are thin 1-2 px darker rows, so the floor props sit weakly on the carpet.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4: pieces lift off the surface through a blob shadow
issues.fix: Add a dithered elliptical contact shadow 2-3 px tall with about 25% indigo tint under each floor prop.

issues.problem: The box flaps and edges are hard straight isometric lines with no highlight bevel. They read slightly harder than the rounded bed posts and toys.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5: every edge is beveled or rounded
issues.fix: Add a 1 px lighter highlight row along the top edge of each box and flap to suggest a soft cardboard bevel.

issues.problem: The large saturated purple duvet has the highest chroma in the frame, so on first look it competes with the intended focus (the open boxes and the hovered boombox).
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6: one obvious focal point
issues.fix: Lower the duvet's saturation by about 10-15%, or add a subtle highlight or outline to the hovered boombox.

issues.region: top edge above the bed frame, and bottom-centre floor corner
issues.problem: The top of the room walls and the front floor corner are cropped by the frame edges, so the diorama has no breathing room top or bottom.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: breathing room, no awkward tangents
issues.fix: Zoom out about 8% so the whole room box fits with about 24 px of margin top and bottom.

issues.problem: The right wall's outer edge runs close and parallel to the frame edge, which creates a near-tangent.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: awkward tangents
issues.fix: Recentre the room horizontally by about 20 px so the margins to the left and right edges match.

issues.region: background outside room, left and right edges
issues.problem: The purple checker backdrop tiles in an obvious uniform grid, which reads as a flat placeholder next to the textured room.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10: no visible tiling
issues.fix: Replace it with a soft vignetted gradient, or vary the checker tones by about ±3% with a gentle radial falloff.

issues.region: top-center prompt line and bottom instruction line
issues.problem: The heavy slab-serif text with its flat drop shadow reads as a digital overlay. It doesn't look like part of the sculpted clay world the plates and swirl belong to.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1 (one handcrafted world); §4.1 reference-band minor flaw
issues.fix: Set the prompt and instruction in the rounded display face, and swap the hard black drop shadow for a 2px soft shadow tinted navy (about 40% opacity).

issues.problem: The timer numerals are a third typographic style: a glossy white bubble face that doesn't match the clay plates or the handwritten caps.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 1; §4.1 minor flaw
issues.fix: Put the timer on a small clay plate that matches the answer cards, using the same handwritten face in dark navy.

issues.problem: The prompt, which is the question the whole screen is about, is set about 22px tall at 720p. It's the smallest of the key text, so it reads second to the cards.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 2 (critical text size at stream quality)
issues.fix: Raise the prompt to about 30px at 720p and give it a 3px navy outline so it survives JPEG q60.

issues.problem: The instruction text is near-pure white on saturated blue. It is the one untinted value in an otherwise harmonised blue and lavender palette.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 3 (no pure white)
issues.fix: Tint the instruction text to the plate lavender-cream, about #F3F0FF.

issues.problem: The plates get a flat, even front light with only a faint cast shadow, so they don't lift much off the swirl compared with the central glow.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 4 (pieces lift off the background)
issues.fix: Add a soft contact shadow tinted deep blue under each plate (offset 6px, blur 18px, about 35% opacity) and a slight upper-left falloff across the plate faces.

issues.problem: The room-code block has near-square corners and a rigid bevel. It is harder-edged than the soft, lumpy clay plates.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 5 (every edge rounded)
issues.fix: Raise the block's corner radius to about 12px and soften the bevel to match the plates' pillowy edge.

issues.problem: The teal 'or' token is small and low-contrast against the glowing blue centre, so the either/or link between the two choices is weak.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 6 (action → state → context)
issues.fix: Scale the token up about 30% and set 'or' in cream on a darker teal bead.

issues.problem: The two plates and the 'or' bead nearly touch, a tangent that crowds the middle of the composition.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (awkward tangents)
issues.fix: Move each plate about 16px outward to leave clear space around the bead.

issues.problem: The timer sits close to the top-left corner and doesn't line up with the room-code block's margin on the right.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 7 (breathing room, balance)
issues.fix: Match the margins: put the timer about 60px from the left and align its baseline with the room-code block's centre.

issues.problem: There is a stray double space in 'Pick  your favorite'.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.1 minor flaw (stray double space); item 8
issues.fix: Collapse it to a single space.

issues.problem: The frame uses three unrelated typefaces (handwritten caps, heavy slab serif, bubble numerals), which weakens the type system.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 8 (correct, limited families)
issues.fix: Cut to two families: the handwritten face for content, and one rounded sans for the prompt, instructions and timer.

issues.problem: The room-code block's hard black drop shadow doesn't match the soft shadow on the answer plates.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 9 (consistent shadows)
issues.fix: Give the room-code block the plates' soft, blue-tinted shadow.

issues.problem: The outer swirl is softer and blurrier than the crisp clay texture on the plates, so it loses some sense of material.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 10 (no blurry art)
issues.fix: Keep depth-of-field blur only in the far centre and restore fingerprint and tool-mark detail on the outer swirl.

issues.problem: The teal text on the teal-blue bead is well under 4.5:1 contrast.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 11 (contrast ≥ 4.5:1)
issues.fix: Set 'or' in #F3F0FF on a #1E6E78 bead.

issues.problem: The overlay text styling looks slightly generic and template-like next to the bespoke clay art, which takes the premium feel down a notch.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 15
issues.fix: Apply the clay-world type treatment (rounded face, tinted soft shadow) to all overlay text.

issues.problem: The timer is a bare number with no ring or icon, so viewers may not immediately recognise it as a countdown.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 17 (timer clear)
issues.fix: Add a depleting clay ring or clock glyph around the numerals.

issues.problem: The join URL above the room code is small, about 14px at 720p, and is marginal at stream quality.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 17 (room code/join info legible)
issues.fix: Raise the URL to about 18px and put it on the block with the code.

issues.problem: There is faint banding in the bright blue radial glow.
issues.rule: RUBRIC §4.2 item 18 (no banding)
issues.fix: Add a 1–2 LSB dither noise to the glow gradient.

issues.region: top-centre prompt and bottom-centre instruction lines
issues.problem: The heavy slab-serif prompt and instruction text with a flat outline reads as a generic overlay, not part of the hand-sculpted clay world the plates, tunnel and room-code badge share.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 1: every element reads as one handcrafted world (reference band, minor flaw)
issues.fix: Set the prompt and CTA on a soft clay ribbon or paper strip with a 2–3 px tinted drop shadow so the text sits in the same material language.

issues.problem: The white CTA sits straight on the mid-blue swirl with no backing, so under stream compression its edges soften against the lighter tunnel ridges.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 2: critical text clear within 1 s at 720p JPEG q60
issues.fix: Add a 4 px dark-navy outline or a 40% navy backing pill behind the CTA.

issues.problem: The saturated lemon-yellow prompt is the one hot accent in an otherwise disciplined blue monochrome and pulls slightly off-harmony.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 3: harmonised hues, controlled saturation (one hot accent, 0.2)
issues.fix: Shift the prompt yellow toward a warmer, less saturated butter (≈ #F2D27A) to match the clay palette.

issues.problem: The cyan glow at the tunnel centre blooms hot and a little flat, briefly competing with the soft ambient clay lighting on the plates.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 4: deliberate, polished lighting model (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Cut the centre bloom intensity by about 25% and tint it toward the tunnel blue so it falls off more softly.

issues.problem: The room-code slab has near-square corners and a hard bottom edge, unlike the pillowy rounded answer plates.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 5: every edge beveled or rounded, chunky toy silhouettes
issues.fix: Give the badge an 8–10 px corner radius and a softened bevel matching the plates.

issues.problem: The prompt that frames the choice is small relative to the plates, so the eye lands on the answers before it knows the question.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 6: eye moves action → state → context (minor)
issues.fix: Raise the prompt size by about 20% (≈ 34 px at 720p) so question and answers read as one unit.

issues.problem: The timer digits sit tight in the corner (≈ 90 px from the left and 55 px from the top) with no framing, which looks tacked on next to the balanced central composition.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 7: breathing room, no awkward placement
issues.fix: Inset the timer to match the room-code badge margins (≈ 60 px) and put it on a matching clay token.

issues.problem: There is a stray double space between 'Pick' and 'your'.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 8: typographic craft (stray double space, 0.1–0.2)
issues.fix: Collapse the text to a single space: 'Pick your favorite on your device now!'

issues.problem: '"TURBO"' breaks onto a short second line and hugs the lower-left edge, so the plate text is unevenly balanced.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 8: no widows, correct scale steps
issues.fix: Rebalance the line breaks ('CHANGE YOUR NAME / TO "TURBO"') or reduce the size one step so the text sits centred.

issues.problem: The plates are placed asymmetrically (the left sits about 25 px lower and closer to the 'or' drop), so the spacing around the centre connector is uneven.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 9: consistent spacing
issues.fix: Align the plate centres vertically and equalise the gaps to the 'or' drop (≈ 16 px each side).

issues.problem: The outer tunnel ridges go soft and smeary, so the clay material reads less crisply than on the plates.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 10: materials read with subtle grain (one soft texture, 0.1)
issues.fix: Add a light fingerprint and grain normal detail to the tunnel material, or reduce the depth-of-field blur on the near ridges.

issues.problem: The yellow prompt's thin dark outline is weak against the mid-blue, so contrast drops on the lighter ridges.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 11: contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in principle
issues.fix: Thicken the outline to 3 px navy or deepen the backdrop behind the prompt.

issues.problem: The flat overlay text is the only element that feels less premium than the sculpted clay set.
issues.rule: RUBRIC item 15: a stranger believes it's premium indie (minor flaw)
issues.fix: Integrate the prompt and CTA into clay or paper carriers, as in CAL-R1-01.
